Divya Sundaram  
📞 +91 9876543210 | 📧 divya.sundaram@example.com | 📍 Mumbai, Maharashtra  

A QA/Test Engineer with 2 years of experience in fintech, specializing in test automation and API testing. Focused on optimizing test processes within small teams, contributing to a 30% reduction in regression testing time through Playwright-based automation. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with financial regulations and maintain system reliability in high-stakes environments.  

At FinTech Innovators Pvt. Ltd., I transitioned from manual testing of payment gateway workflows to leading test strategy design for microservices-based fraud detection systems. My work involved building regression test suites for loan approval APIs, which covered 85% of endpoints and identified critical vulnerabilities in real-time transaction processing. In the Test Automation Engineer role, I introduced end-to-end testing for mobile banking apps, reducing manual test cases by 40% while improving coverage for edge scenarios. Currently, I lead test strategy design for microservices, ensuring 99.9% uptime during peak transaction volumes.  

Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science, Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay (2022). Graduated with a focus on software engineering principles, which underpin my approach to test automation and system integration.  

Technical Skills:  
- **API testing**: Designed and executed regression test suites for loan approval APIs, ensuring 95%+ coverage of endpoints.  
- **Integration testing**: Validated seamless data flow between payment gateways and backend systems, resolving 15+ integration issues.  
- **Java**: Utilized for scripting custom test cases in legacy systems, enhancing test suite maintainability.  
- **Python**: Automated report generation and data validation scripts for compliance audits.  
- **REST API design**: Contributed to documentation and validation of REST endpoints for fraud detection microservices.  
- **Selenium/Playwright**: Developed end-to-end test scripts for mobile banking apps, achieving 90% test case automation.  
- **Test automation**: Streamlined test execution pipelines, reducing manual intervention by 35% in regression cycles.  
- **Unit testing**: Implemented unit tests for core components of payment processing modules, improving defect detection in early stages.  
- **JavaScript**: Incorporated for dynamic form validation and UI interaction testing in browser-based workflows.  
- **Test strategy design**: Defined test approaches for microservices, aligning with CI/CD pipelines and security requirements.  

Projects:  
- **Mobile Banking App Automation**: Pioneered Playwright-based end-to-end testing, covering 120+ user journeys, resulting in a 40% reduction in manual test cases.  
- **Fraud Detection System Testing**: Designed test strategies for microservices, ensuring 99.9% uptime during peak transaction loads and identifying 20+ critical race conditions.  

Languages: English (fluent), Hindi (native)
